subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report and preferred transfer method
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@bluepeakhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report and preferred transfer method

Hi Alex,

Hope you’re well — quick intro from Redwood’s assurance intake team. We’re preparing a compliance review for an upcoming customer assessment and would like to request your latest SOC 2 Type II report covering the period you have (we expect many customers will ask for the 12-month window you tested). A couple of clarifying asks to speed this along: 

1) Audit period: please confirm the start/end dates of the Type II period (e.g., 2025-06-01 to 2026-05-31).
2) Bridge letter: if your report is older than 12 months, would you be able to provide a bridge letter outlining any material changes since the report end date?
3) Transfer preference: we can accept the report via (a) presigned S3 link, (b) secure temporary SFTP account, or (c) DocuSign/secure Share link for the PDF. Please let us know which you prefer and any restrictions for redaction.
4) Supporting artifacts: if feasible, please include your standard bridge letter (if available) and a short list of representative artifacts (log sample, change control snapshot, or evidence manifest). If you can’t share raw artifacts, a signed SOC 2 report + bridge letter will be sufficient for our intake team.

Below are two short reply templates you can use; whichever is easiest for your security team is fine: 

- One-line minimal reply (fast):
  "Happy to share. Audit period: 2025-06-01 to 2026-05-31. Preferred transfer: presigned S3. Attaching report and bridge letter."

- Full reply (recommended for security teams):
  "Hi Jonas — attaching our SOC 2 Type II report (2025-06-01 - 2026-05-31) and a bridge letter dated 2026-06-01. Preferred transfer: presigned S3 link. We have redacted internal employee IDs and account numbers; telemetry/log extracts are available on request under an NDA or secure transfer. Contact security@bluepeakhealth.com for any additional artifacts."

If it helps, we can accept a redacted PDF for initial review and request specific telemetry samples later. We’ll treat any evidence you share as confidential under our intake controls and will share only with the named audit reviewers.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Security Intake | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0187

Jonas — thanks for the clear note.

Quick answers:
- Audit period: 2025-06-01 to 2026-05-31.
- Bridge letter: yes, we produced a bridge letter on 2026-06-01 that covers minor non-material configuration changes.
- Transfer preference: presigned S3 is easiest for our team today; we can also do secure SFTP if you require it.

I’ve attached the PDF report and the bridge letter for your intake team to review. We have redacted internal PII and employee IDs from the copy; if you need raw telemetry or non-redacted artifacts for the audit team, we’ll require a short transfer agreement (I can loop legal).

Let me know if you need anything else.

—Alex

Alex — thanks for the fast turnaround and for attaching the files. I confirmed receipt of the two PDFs and briefed our audit reviewers. A couple quick operational notes: 

- We will use the presigned S3 link you provide; when you generate it please set a 7-day expiry and include read-only permissions.
- Redaction is fine for the initial review. If/when the auditor requests additional artifacts we’ll circle back to you with a scoped ask and transfer agreement.
- For traceability, can you add the following tag or filename pattern to the presigned payload: DP-9483_SOC2_{filename}.pdf ? That helps our intake automation attach evidence to the right deal record.

If your legal team prefers an MSA addendum or short transfer agreement before sending raw logs, we can accept the redacted PDF now and await the agreement for any further artifacts.

Thanks again — we’ll confirm once the intake scan completes.

Kimberly Park
Security Intake Lead | Redwood Inference
